verdict.rationale: Highnote docs confirm a dedicated Disputes Team and API-driven dispute case creation/lifecycle simulation in the Test environment, plus general webhook infrastructure for event notifications. However, there's no specific evidence of network reason code handling, evidence/documentation submission workflows, or provisional credit mechanics, nor explicit confirmation that dispute status changes trigger webhooks. Missing for 10: network reason code documentation, evidence submission API details, provisional credit handling specifics, dispute-specific webhook event confirmation.
